dialogue.content: （今晩は。宜しくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Good evening. I look forward to our session.)

dialogue.content: （よろしくお願い致します。）
dialogue.English: (Yes, you too.)

dialogue.content: こんばんは。相談員です。来ていただき、ありがとうございます。最初に、年齢・性別・ご相談内容を教えていただけますか?
dialogue.English: Good evening. I'm the counselor. Thank you for coming. First, could you please tell me your age, gender, and what you'd like to discuss?

dialogue.content: 16歳　女性
dialogue.English: 16, female.

dialogue.content: 眠れない　食べれない
dialogue.English: Can't sleep, can't eat.

dialogue.content: 教えていただき、ありがとうございます。そうでしたか。そのことで悩んでいらしたのですね?
dialogue.English: Thank you for sharing that. I see. So that's what's been troubling you?

dialogue.content: 眠れる方法知りたい
dialogue.English: I want to know how to sleep.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。いろいろくわしく教えてくださいね。
dialogue.English: I understand. Please tell me more about it.

dialogue.content: 何を？
dialogue.English: About what?

dialogue.content: 私が知りたいです
dialogue.English: I'm the one who wants to know.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。もう少しお話お聞かせくださいね。いつ頃から、そのようになったのでしょう?
dialogue.English: That's right. Please tell me a little more. When did this start happening?

dialogue.content: 眠れないのはけっこう前から
dialogue.English: I haven't been able to sleep for quite a while.

dialogue.content: 食べれないのは最近
dialogue.English: Not being able to eat is recent.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。そのような状態で、来ていただいたのですね。お辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. So you came here while going through all that. It must be very difficult.

dialogue.content: 何か、きっかけのようなものがありました?
dialogue.English: Was there anything that might have triggered it?

dialogue.content: 親が離婚して
dialogue.English: My parents got divorced.

dialogue.content: 母が出ていきました
dialogue.English: My mother left.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。その頃からなのですね。
dialogue.English: I see... So it started around then.

dialogue.content: もう無理
dialogue.English: I can't take it anymore.

dialogue.content: 生きてたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to live.

dialogue.content: そのように苦しいのですね。お母様が出ていかれてから、ご飯とかはどうしているのですか?
dialogue.English: It's that painful for you. Since your mother left, how have you been handling meals?

dialogue.content: 各自
dialogue.English: We each fend for ourselves.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、大変ですよね。ご兄弟がいらっしゃるのですね?
dialogue.English: I see, that must be tough. Do you have siblings?

dialogue.content: いますけど
dialogue.English: I do, but...

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。生活費とかははどうされているのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. How are you managing living expenses and things like that?

dialogue.content: それ聞いて眠れるようになりますか？
dialogue.English: How is asking that going to help me sleep?

dialogue.content: 相談者様がどのように生活されているのか、心配です。
dialogue.English: I'm concerned about how you're living day to day.

dialogue.content: 普通に暮らしてる
dialogue.English: I'm just living normally.

dialogue.content: お母様が出ていかれてから、生活がだいぶかわられたのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: Has your life changed a lot since your mother left?

dialogue.content: だから普通
dialogue.English: I told you, it's normal.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お母様が出ていらした時って、どんなお気持ちだったのでしよう?
dialogue.English: I understand. When your mother left, what were you feeling?

dialogue.content: だから死にたい
dialogue.English: That's why I want to die.

dialogue.content: 生きてたくない
dialogue.English: I don't want to live.

dialogue.content: そのように思われるほど、ショックだったのですね…。
dialogue.English: It must have been such a shock that you feel this way...

dialogue.content: 最近、眠れなくなった、とのことですが、同じようなことが原因でしょうか?
dialogue.English: You mentioned you couldn't sleep recently; is it for a similar reason?

dialogue.content: 眠れないのはその前から
dialogue.English: I couldn't sleep even before that.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。何か出来事とか、ありました?
dialogue.English: I see. Was there any event or anything?

dialogue.content: 睡眠障害だから
dialogue.English: Because I have a sleep disorder.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。ずいぶん長く続いているのですか?
dialogue.English: I see... Has it been going on for a long time?

dialogue.content: 一度病院で言われて
dialogue.English: I was told that once at a hospital.

dialogue.content: でも先生と合わなくて
dialogue.English: But I didn't get along with the doctor.

dialogue.content: 今は行ってない
dialogue.English: I'm not going now.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。何もお薬とか飲んでいないのですね?
dialogue.English: I see. So you're not taking any medication?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: That's right.

dialogue.content: 夜は何時間ぐらいねむれているのでしょう?
dialogue.English: About how many hours of sleep are you getting at night?

dialogue.content: それ聞いたら眠れるようになりますか
dialogue.English: How is asking that going to help me sleep?

dialogue.content: 睡眠障害とのことですが、どのくらい眠れないのかなと思いました。
dialogue.English: You mentioned a sleep disorder, so I was wondering just how much you're unable to sleep.

dialogue.content: アロマ炊いたり
dialogue.English: I've tried using an aromatherapy diffuser,

dialogue.content: 音楽きいたり
dialogue.English: listening to music,

dialogue.content: いろいろしたけど無理
dialogue.English: I've tried a lot of things, but nothing works.

dialogue.content: そうだったのですね。打ちひしがれてしまいますよね。それでは学校に行ったとき、すごく眠くなるのでしょうね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be so disheartening. I imagine you must get very sleepy when you go to school.

dialogue.content: 眠れないなって思うと、どんなお気持ちになるのでしょう?
dialogue.English: When you think, "I can't sleep," what kind of feelings come up?

dialogue.content: 困る
dialogue.English: It's distressing.

dialogue.content: そうですよね。寝たいのに眠れない、すごく辛いですよね。
dialogue.English: I can imagine. Wanting to sleep but not being able to is very hard, isn't it?

dialogue.content: まあ、はい
dialogue.English: Well, yes.

dialogue.content: その分、他の時間で眠くなったりします?
dialogue.English: Do you end up getting sleepy at other times to make up for it?

dialogue.content: 特にはない
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。それでは体が疲れてしまいますよね。学校には行けてます?
dialogue.English: I see. That must be exhausting for your body. Are you able to go to school?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: 頑張り屋さんなのですね。ご飯も食べれない、とのことですが、少しは食べれるのですか?
dialogue.English: You're quite the hard worker. You said you can't eat, but are you able to eat a little?

dialogue.content: お弁当だけ
dialogue.English: Just my bento box.

dialogue.content: 昼の
dialogue.English: For lunch.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか、それでは全然足りないですよね。相談者様のこのような状態について、お父様は何かおっしゃいます?
dialogue.English: I see, that's not nearly enough, is it? Does your father say anything about your situation?

dialogue.content: あんまり話さないから
dialogue.English: We don't talk much.

dialogue.content: 忙しいし
dialogue.English: And he's busy.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか。寂しいですよね。
dialogue.English: I see. That must be lonely.

dialogue.content: 別に、みんなバラバラだし
dialogue.English: Not really, everyone just does their own thing.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お母様がいらした時は、普通に食べれていたのですね?
dialogue.English: I see. When your mother was around, were you able to eat normally?

dialogue.content: 普通って何ですか
dialogue.English: What's "normally"?

dialogue.content: 分かりにくい言い方で、すみません。
dialogue.English: I'm sorry, that was an unclear way to put it.

dialogue.content: いえ
dialogue.English: It's fine.

dialogue.content: 朝と晩はご飯を食べていらしたのですね?
dialogue.English: Did you used to eat breakfast and dinner?

dialogue.content: 答えたくなければ答えなくていいですよ。昼のお弁当は、コンビニとかで買うのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: You don't have to answer if you don't want to. Do you buy your lunch at a convenience store or somewhere?

dialogue.content: 作る時も買う時もあり
dialogue.English: Sometimes I make it, sometimes I buy it.

dialogue.content: ある
dialogue.English: Yes, there are.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。ご自身で作っていらして。すごいことですね。
dialogue.English: I see. You make it yourself sometimes. That's amazing.

dialogue.content: そんなことない
dialogue.English: Not really.

dialogue.content: 朝とか夜のご飯は、買ったり、作ろう、とは思わないのですね?
dialogue.English: So you don't think about buying or making breakfast or dinner?

dialogue.content: また、分かりづらいですね。学校で、クラスメートと一緒に食べるお弁当は、たべられるのですね?
dialogue.English: That was unclear again, wasn't it? So, you're able to eat your bento at school with your classmates?

dialogue.content: それ聞いてどうするんですか
dialogue.English: What are you going to do with that information?

dialogue.content: 相談者様にとって、食べる空間って、一人では食欲がわかないのかな、と思いました。
dialogue.English: I wondered whether, for you, the eating environment matters—maybe you don't have much appetite when you're alone.

dialogue.content: 眠れなかったり、食べれなかったりが続いて…。体調の方はどうですか?
dialogue.English: With this continuing lack of sleep and food... how is your physical health?

dialogue.content: 眠れるようになるにはどうしたらいいか教えてください
dialogue.English: Please just tell me what to do to be able to sleep.

dialogue.content: そのように思われるのですね。睡眠障害…、との診断が出ているのであれば、思春期外来の別の専門病院を考えましたが…。
dialogue.English: I understand that's what you want. Since you've been diagnosed with a sleep disorder... I was thinking about another specialized hospital, maybe an adolescent clinic...

dialogue.content: でも、薬を使わずに眠りたいのでしょうね。お母様がいらした時の、楽しかった思い出を思い出してみるのは、どうでしよう?
dialogue.English: But you probably want to sleep without medication, right? How about trying to recall some happy memories from when your mother was with you?

dialogue.content: 病院お金かかるから行きにくいし
dialogue.English: Hospitals are expensive, so it's hard to go.

dialogue.content: もういいです
dialogue.English: It's fine, forget it.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。眠る時も、緊張していらっしゃるのもあるのでしようか?
dialogue.English: I see. Is it possible that you're also tense when you try to sleep?

dialogue.content: いろいろとリラックスできるように、試してみたんですものね。
dialogue.English: You've already tried various things to relax, haven't you.

dialogue.content: 眠ろうとする時って、何かg気がかりなこととか、嫌な思い出とか出て来ます?
dialogue.English: When you try to sleep, do any worries or unpleasant memories come to mind?

dialogue.content: （gは余計でした）
dialogue.English: (The 'g' was a typo.)

dialogue.content: よくわからない
dialogue.English: I don't really know.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者の眠りを妨げようとする、何か原因があるのかもしれませんね。
dialogue.English: I see. There might be some underlying cause that's trying to interfere with your sleep.

dialogue.content: 先生と合わなくて…、とのことですが、何か言われたり、とかて゛しようか?
dialogue.English: You mentioned you didn't get along with the doctor... was it something they said?

dialogue.content: 一方的だったから
dialogue.English: Because it was one-sided.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。相談者のお気持ちを聴いてもらいたかった感じでしょうか?
dialogue.English: I see. Does it feel like you wanted them to listen to your feelings?

dialogue.content: 失礼しました、相談者様の、でした。何か押し付けられるような感じだったのでしょうか?
dialogue.English: My apologies, I meant *your* feelings. Did you feel like they were forcing their opinions on you?

dialogue.content: 病院に通っていらした時は眠れていたのでしようか?
dialogue.English: Were you able to sleep when you were going to the hospital?

dialogue.content: 眠れないから病院行きました
dialogue.English: I went to the hospital because I couldn't sleep.

dialogue.content: そうなのですね。お金がかかる、とのことですが…。気が進まないかもしれませんが、お父様に相談されて、もう一度病院に行かれるのはいかがでしょう?
dialogue.English: I understand. You mentioned the cost... I know you might be reluctant, but how about talking to your father and trying to go to the hospital again?

dialogue.content: お金がないから無理
dialogue.English: No money, so it's impossible.

dialogue.content: そうでしたか…。すみません、お時間になってしまいました。またこの続きをお話しにいらして下さい。私もこのことを考えてみます。
dialogue.English: I see... I'm sorry, but our time is up. Please come back to continue this conversation. I will also think about this.

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Okay.

dialogue.content: 大変申し訳ありません。これで終了とさせて頂いてもよろしいでしょうか。
dialogue.English: I'm very sorry about this. Is it alright if we end the session here?

dialogue.content: はい
dialogue.English: Yes.

dialogue.content: またお話お聞かせ下さい。（ありがとうございました。）
dialogue.English: Please come and talk again. (Thank you very much.)
